verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a first-party API to "programmatically access and take action on data," including creating issues, plus an incrementally growing endpoint set (e.g. a new GET /task-statuses) and an MCP server that reads and updates issues, accounts and contacts. Nothing documents that the API covers everything the UI can do, and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a published endpoint reference or OpenAPI spec showing coverage of UI features (triggers, knowledge base, analytics, agent configuration, custom fields), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Added a GET /task-statuses API endpoint for enumerating configured task statuses
AI tools authenticate with your Pylon account via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts, and contacts within the data you can see in Pylon.
